string.name: redesign_menu
string.comment: Name of the bottom bar button and of the screen that holds settings, search and tools

string.name: redesign_tools
string.comment: Heading of the list of tools on the Menu screen (history, maintenance, configuration...)

string.name: redesign_needs_attention
string.comment: Heading on the Menu screen over the things the user must set up (pump, missing permissions)

string.name: redesign_close_menu
string.comment: Screen reader action of the Menu button while the Menu screen is open

resources.string: Close the menu and go back to the home screen

string.name: redesign_edit_mode
string.comment: Two places with the same words: the Menu shortcut that shows the graphs page with the buttons to add, change and remove graphs, and the label at the top of that page while it is in this mode

string.name: redesign_edit_done
string.comment: Button that leaves the edit mode of the graphs page

string.name: redesign_page_home
string.comment: Screen reader name of the first page of the overview

string.name: redesign_page_graphs
string.comment: Screen reader name of the second page of the overview

string.name: redesign_open_graphs
string.comment: Screen reader action of the glucose value on the home page: it shows the graphs page

string.name: redesign_tile_profile
string.comment: Tile label: the active insulin profile

string.name: redesign_tile_active_insulin
string.comment: Tile label: insulin on board. Short, the tile is about 150 dp wide

string.name: redesign_tile_carbs
string.comment: Tile label: carbs on board

string.name: redesign_tile_basal
string.comment: Tile label: the basal rate of the profile

string.name: redesign_tile_temp_basal
string.comment: Tile label while a temporary basal rate runs. Very short

string.name: redesign_tile_pump
string.comment: Tile label while the pump is disconnected, and caption of the pump activity button

string.name: redesign_mode_closed
string.comment: Loop tile value: closed loop

string.name: redesign_mode_open
string.comment: Loop tile value: open loop

string.name: redesign_mode_lgs
string.comment: Loop tile value: low glucose suspend mode

string.name: redesign_mode_paused_no_time
string.comment: Loop tile value: the loop is suspended, no end time known

string.name: redesign_mode_disconnected
string.comment: Loop tile value: the pump is disconnected

string.name: redesign_mode_disabled
string.comment: Loop tile value: the loop is disabled

string.name: redesign_carbs_required
string.comment: Small text after the carbs on board when the loop says more carbs are needed. %1$d=grams. Example: 13 required

string.name: redesign_sensitivity
string.comment: Label of the sensitivity line on the home page (autosens or dynamic ISF)

string.name: redesign_isf
string.comment: Abbreviation of insulin sensitivity factor, as in the rest of the app

string.name: redesign_sensitivity_description
string.comment: Screen reader text of the sensitivity line. %1$s=sensitivity in percent, %2$s=ISF of the profile, %3$s=ISF used. Example: Sensitivity 80 %, profile ISF 36, ISF used 45 mg/dL

string.name: redesign_bg_doubled
string.comment: Short reason under the BG source name: the source sends every value twice

string.name: redesign_bg_flat
string.comment: Short reason under the BG source name: the values do not change

string.name: redesign_bg_problem_description
string.comment: Screen reader text of the BG source button. %1$s=reason (Duplicates, Flat data), %2$s=source name. Example: Glucose data problem: duplicates. Open the source xDrip+

resources.string: Glucose data problem: %1$s. Open the source %2$s

string.name: redesign_meal
string.comment: Caption of the eat reminder button under the minutes left

string.name: redesign_meal_now
string.comment: Eat reminder button when the time to eat has come. Very short

string.name: redesign_meal_description
string.comment: Screen reader text of the eat reminder button. %1$s=minutes left or Now. Example: Meal reminder: 12 min. Open

string.name: redesign_pump_activity_description
string.comment: Screen reader text of the pump activity button

string.name: redesign_pump_activity_status_description
string.comment: Screen reader text of the pump activity button. %1$s=what the pump does, in the words of the pump status banner. Example: Pump activity: Setting temp basal. Open

string.name: redesign_target_description
string.comment: Screen reader text of the Target button. %1$s=target range or value. Example: Target: 120-130

string.name: redesign_target_description_left
string.comment: Screen reader text of the Target button during a temporary target. %1$s=target value, %2$s=time left. Example: Target: 140, 45 min left

string.name: redesign_graph_range
string.comment: Button over the home glucose graph: how many hours it shows. Very short. %1$d=hours. Example: 6 h

string.name: redesign_graph_range_description
string.comment: Screen reader name of a range button of the home glucose graph. %1$d=hours, always 3 or more. Example: 6 hours

string.name: redesign_graph_ranges
string.comment: Screen reader name of the row of range buttons (3 h, 6 h, 12 h…) over the home glucose graph

string.name: redesign_graph_hour
string.comment: Hour label under the home glucose graph. Very short. %1$d=hour of the day, 0 to 23. Example: 19h

string.name: redesign_graph_description
string.comment: Screen reader text of the home glucose graph. %1$s=time shown, %2$s=last glucose value with unit. Example: Glucose over the last 6 hours, now 133 mg/dL. Long press to read a value

resources.string: Glucose over the last %1$s, now %2$s. Long press to read a value

string.name: redesign_graph_description_no_value
string.comment: Screen reader text of the home glucose graph when it has no reading. %1$s=time shown. Example: Glucose over the last 6 hours. No reading

resources.string: Glucose over the last %1$s. No reading

string.name: redesign_graphs
string.comment: Bottom bar item that shows the graphs page. Short, one word

string.name: redesign_close_graphs
string.comment: Screen reader action of the Graphs bottom bar item while the graphs page is shown: the same button goes back to the home page

string.name: redesign_open_pump_menu
string.comment: Screen reader action of the patch pump row in the consumables panel: opens the pump's own screen

string.name: redesign_add_sensor
string.comment: Screen reader name of the small round (+) button next to Sensor in the consumables panel

string.name: redesign_age_max_days
string.comment: Longest age of a sensor or patch, short, whole days only. d=days. %1$d=days. Example: 3d

string.name: redesign_value_of_max
string.comment: Value and its maximum in the consumables panel. %1$s=value, %2$s=maximum. Example: 2d17h / 3d
